title: One lifecycle contract across discover, load, ready, infer, cancel, unload and health
goal: VC-201-042 claims one lifecycle contract covering discover, load, ready, infer, cancel, unload and health for supported native and HTTP-managed runtimes, with typed errors for unsupported operations and readiness that process presence cannot establish. The tree has NativeInferenceEngine and a RuntimeSubstrate::unload; it has no contract spanning the seven, and nothing that establishes readiness beyond process presence. The mastery test that asserted the vector (ff8d8713) exists only on an unmerged branch: zero files named vc_201_042_mastery are tracked on main, so the delivered narrative rested on evidence that was never landed.
